risk_note: Payout path, RV2. W8 (adminBatchManualPaid, BR-WDR-16): a paid_at strictly earlier than the withdrawal's reviewed_at is not refused (an offline payment can precede the click on 通过; D10-678 ①): the audit withdrawal_manual_paid carries after.paid_before_review = true and, after the item's transaction commits, one warn payout_manual_paid_before_review (app_id, withdrawal_id only) goes out for operations to review. Equal or later paid_at, or a null reviewed_at, changes nothing. Amounts, status transition, vouchers, balance and tax are untouched.

reviews.note: Codex via codex-run.sh (D10-823, D10-1025), effort medium (D10-884), base the last test(spec) commit; no findings (couli-runs/B2-09zh/money-review-r1.json).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests in 2 attempts by a fresh independent Claude: 1st 8 cases; 2nd only added #9 (a rolled-back item does not alert: the second item's audit insert fails → 50001, only the committed first warned; same-key retry warns each once) and #10 (millisecond precision), the spec-test r1 findings. spec-test by a fresh independent Claude as D10-848 requires for a claude-independent author: r1 (spec-test-review-r1.json) fail 1 S1 + 1 S2, closed by the 2nd attempt; r2 (spec-test-review-r2.json) pass with one S2 left open: a warn between the audit insert and COMMIT would need a commit-failure fault to be caught (the implementation warns after the commit). Red: red/3 ok, 10 tests in 1 file. Mutations (couli-runs/B2-09zh/mutations.md).
